description: Apply a list of operations to the active PCB as ONE change. The design rule check runs before and after (guard): a new error other than a not-yet-routed connection (clearance, short, overlap with a keep-out) takes the whole change back, as does a failed op; pours are refilled before judging. trial:true reports and takes it back in any case. Coordinates in mil, y up (unit:'mm' for millimetres); layer by number or name (top, bottom, topsilk, bottomsilk, outline, document, inner1...). ops: {op:'track',net,layer,points:[x1,y1,x2,y2,...],width?} | {op:'via',net,x,y,hole?,dia?} | {op:'move',part:'R1',x?,y?,rot?,layer?} | {op:'place',lcsc|device|footprint,x,y,layer?,rot?,des?} | {op:'set',part,props} | {op:'outline',rect:[x,y,w,h]|points:[...]|circle:[x,y,r]} | {op:'pour',net,layer,rect|points,name?,priority?} | {op:'region',layer,rect|points,rules?} (keep-out) | {op:'fill',layer,rect|points|circle,net?} | {op:'text',layer,x,y,text,size?,width?,rot?} | {op:'line',layer,points,width?} (silkscreen or document line) | {op:'delete',ids:[...]}. A rectangle starts at its top left corner. Components normally come from the schematic (pcb_do action:'import'); deleted shapes, texts and components cannot be put back by a rollback, tracks and vias can.

allowErrors.description: Keep the change even if it adds rule errors (they are still reported).

guard.description: Default true. false skips the rule checks.

rebuild.description: Default true: refill pours before the rule check.

rollback.description: Default true: take everything back on a failed op or a new rule error.

trial.description: Do it, report the rule check, then take everything back.
